### Next renderer levers after G1's exact part

`proposed` · `@exprim.renderer.next-levers/1`

Candidates ranked by measured share, none started:
1. Stroke outlines as ribbons with fewer join polygons (changes pixels;
   default on with a knob for old bytes, per the user's decision).
2. Error-bounded curve flattening for fills and clips (changes pixels,
   same policy).
3. Per-tile fixed cost of tiling-cell lowering (exact; 40% of the map's
   remaining time).
4. Constant-time tile cull test over the shape mask (exact; 5.7%).
5. Temporary allocations in stroke and tile lowering (exact; about 10%).
6. RenderSession RGB output without the packing pass (exact; 47% of a
   warm session text page).
7. Compile cost on first renders of table and text pages.
8. Masked draws under a mostly opaque clip mask: needs a row-detail
   profile first.
Dropped on evidence: exact floor/ceil replacements, a trig table.
